name: DemoBaseplate
_comment: Pillow-block base plate. Origin-centered so face-sketch children resolve (known_limitations §1). Axis-aligned Front extrude (§2). Fillet/chamfer use semantic edge selectors (§4): FIL_Corners fillets the 4 vertical corner edges via between_faces, CHA_TopEdge chamfers all 4 top-face edges via of_face. Driving dims sourced from locals.txt (PLATE_L/PLATE_W/PLATE_T + friends).

features.name: SK_MountSeed
features._comment2: center.u/v is a plain-number field only -- {rhs} is rejected by the schema here (confirmed empirically; every reference example (drive_roller, motor_mount_plate) also leaves center literal even when diameter is parametric). Mirrors PLATE_MOUNT_X/Y literally; keep the two in sync by hand if locals.txt changes.

features.name: LP_Mounts
features._comment: Direction is a point on an edge whose tangent is +/-X (NOT a raw unit vector -- see patterned_plate README 'How direction selection works'). (0, 30, 10) is the midpoint of the +y top edge of the +z face (plate spans x=[-50,50], y=[-30,30], z=[0,10]). flip:true grows the pattern -X->+X so it walks away from the seed at u=-40 toward +X, matching patterned_plate's convention.
features._comment3: direction.x/y/z must be plain numbers -- {rhs} is rejected here (confirmed empirically: 'is not of type number'). (0,30,10) tracks PLATE_W/2=30 and PLATE_T=10 by hand; keep in sync if locals.txt changes.

features.name: MIR_Mounts
features._comment: Top Plane = XZ (y=0): flips Y, taking the v=-20 hole row to v=+20 (mirrored_holes README plane-semantics table).

features.name: FIL_Corners
features._comment: 4 vertical corner edges = the edge shared by each adjacent (x-face, y-face) pair -- between_faces semantic selector (dress_up.py _select_edges), not of_feature/radius-only.

features.name: CHA_TopEdge
features._comment: of_face semantic selector: all edges bounding the +z (top) face.

features.name: CP_BoltCircle
features._comment: Step 6 enrichment (kept -- clean dry-run, patterned_disc idiom). Axis point (-37.5,-20,10) is on the rim of Hole_MountSeed (center -40,-20, dia 5 -> radius 2.5), which SW uses to infer the rotation axis through (-40,-20) normal to +z. 4 small Ø1.5 holes at 90 deg spacing, radius 6mm, around the first mount hole -- a bolt-circle decoration that doesn't touch the corner fillets or the patterned/mirrored mount holes.
